changeSet.author: mcpierce
changeSet.createView: SELECT DISTINCT c.comic_id as comic_id, (SELECT reference_id FROM comic_metadata_sources_v4 m WHERE m.comic_id = c.comic_id) AS reference_id, c.filename as filename, c.archive_type as archive_type, c.comic_state as comic_state, c.missing as is_missing, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT s.comic_id FROM comic_metadata_sources_v4 s WHERE s.comic_id = c.comic_id) THEN false ELSE true END AS is_unscraped, c.comic_type as comic_type, c.sort_name as sort_name, c.publisher as publisher, c.imprint as imprint, c.series as series, c.volume as volume, c.issue_number as issue_number, c.description as description, c.notes as notes, (SELECT RIGHT (CONCAT('0000000000', c.issue_number), 10)) as sortable_issue_number, c.title as title, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comic_pages_v4 cp WHERE cp.comic_id = c.comic_id) as page_count , c.cover_date as cover_date , CASE WHEN c.cover_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cover_date)) END as month_published , CASE WHEN c.cover_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cover_date)) END as year_published, c.store_date as store_date, c.added_date as added_date, c.last_modified_date as last_modified_date FROM comics_v4 c

SELECT DISTINCT c.publisher as publisher, c.series as series, c.volume as volume, c.issue_number as issue_number, c.cover_date as cover_date, COUNT(*) as count FROM comics_v4 c WHERE publisher IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH (publisher) > 0 AND series IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH (series) > 0 AND volume IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH (volume) > 0 AND issue_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH (issue_number) > 0 AND cover_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.publisher, c.series, c.volume, c.issue_number, c.cover_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.file_hash, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cp.comic_id) FROM comic_pages_v4 cp WHERE cp.file_hash = p.file_hash) as comic_count FROM comic_pages_v4 p WHERE p.file_hash IN (SELECT file_hash FROM comic_pages_v4 GROUP BY file_hash HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

SELECT c.comic_id AS comic_id, c.filename, c.archive_type, c.publisher, c.imprint, c.series, c.volume, c.issue_number, c.title, c.cover_date, c.store_date, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT * FROM comic_metadata_sources_v4 WHERE comic_metadata_sources_v4.comic_id = c.comic_id) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_scraped FROM comics_v4 c WHERE c.loading_file_contents IS FALSE AND c.organizing IS TRUE AND c.purging IS FALSE AND c.updating_metadata IS FALSE AND c.target_archive_type IS NULL AND c.editing_metadata IS FALSE

SELECT c1.publisher as name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comics_v4 c2 WHERE c2.publisher = c1.publisher) as issue_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.series) FROM comics_v4 c2 WHERE c2.publisher = c1.publisher AND c2.series IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(c2.series) > 0) AS series_count FROM comics_v4 c1 GROUP BY c1.publisher;

SELECT c.publisher, c.series, c.volume, (COUNT(*)) AS in_library, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues_v4 i WHERE i.publisher = c.publisher AND i.series = c.series AND i.volume = c.volume) AS issue_count FROM comics_v4 c GROUP BY c.publisher, c.series, c.volume;

SELECT t.tag_value AS story_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comics_v4 c WHERE t.comic_id = c.comic_id) AS comic_count FROM comic_tags_v4 t WHERE t.tag_type = 'STORY' UNION SELECT s.story_name AS story_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scraped_story_entries_v4 se WHERE se.scraped_story_id = s.scraped_story_id) AS comic_count FROM scraped_stories_v4 s;
